events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental masterpiece, the 'White Album'. What's your favourite track from this double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. A true classic.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon tragically passed away in 1980; he would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His music and message of peace resonate as strongly today as ever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the innovative and influential musician and artist David Bowie, who passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman. David Bowie would have been 80 today, and his impact on music, fashion, and culture is still felt across generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today. His music still moves millions around the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are simply legendary.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to his incredible solo career, a true rock 'n' roll legend.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his 'blue-eyed soul' hits, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful Celebrations
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That distinctive voice has given us so many unforgettable tracks.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away in 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her incredible songs and spirit live on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and producer Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, he's given us decades of pop anthems.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' and celebrate.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame inducted its first class of legends. Who do you think should be in there now?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member and singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Another year older, still looking 'Relight My Fire' good.

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert on the roof of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles made history with their final live performance on a London rooftop. An unforgettable moment in music.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, songwriter, and actor Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Music Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his solo hits, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 66
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Leading Man Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to darker roles, he always delivers.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Superstar Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo chart-toppers, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, known for iconic roles like Del Boy and Inspector Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: National Treasure Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died', 68 years ago. A tragic loss of pioneering talent that forever changed rock and roll.
